top_strength: Arden gathered comprehensive logistics details (property types, room layouts, specific furniture inventory, box count, special items like the 55" TV) with clear follow-up questions, allowing for a personalized and accurate estimate anchored to both time and price.
coaching_note: Arden skipped the entire Section 2 discovery of customer concerns ('Other than price, what are your biggest concerns?') and jumped straight into probing, and never asked 'Does that feel fair?' after pricing—both are high-leverage moments to build confidence and surface objections before the ask.
